title: Purchaser Requirements Table - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
For each tier of the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans**, the purchaser's DEERS beneficiary category and the personal facts below decide whether the plan may be bought. Ages are in completed years; a minimum age of 0 means the tier sets no minimum.

## Requirements by tier

| Tier | DEERS beneficiary category of the purchaser | Youngest purchase age | Youngest purchase age, full-time student | Must be unmarried | Barred if eligible for FEHB | Barred if eligible for employer coverage through own job | Sponsor status the plan depends on | Must reside in a Prime Service Area |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | Selected Reserve member | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (not applicable) | no | yes | no | the purchaser is a Selected Reserve member not on active duty orders | no |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | Selected Reserve member | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (not applicable) | no | yes | no | the purchaser is a Selected Reserve member not on active duty orders | no |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | young adult dependent | 21 | 23 | yes | no | yes | the sponsor is TRICARE-eligible | no |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | Retired Reserve member | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (not applicable) | no | yes | no | the purchaser is a Retired Reserve member under 60 | no |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | young adult dependent | 21 | 23 | yes | no | yes | the sponsor is TRICARE-eligible | yes |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | Retired Reserve member | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (not applicable) | no | yes | no | the purchaser is a Retired Reserve member under 60 | no |

FEHB is the Federal Employees Health Benefits program. Employer coverage means employer-sponsored coverage based on the purchaser's own employment.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical purchasers)

- A young adult dependent aged 22 who is not a full-time student: the youngest purchase age for the tier is 21, so the age requirement is met. The same young adult enrolled as a full-time student: the youngest purchase age is 23, so it is not yet met.
- A Selected Reserve member who is eligible for FEHB: both TRICARE Reserve Select tiers show "barred if eligible for FEHB - yes".
- A young adult dependent who lives outside a Prime Service Area: only TRICARE Young Adult Prime requires residence in a Prime Service Area; TRICARE Young Adult Select does not.
- A married young adult: both TRICARE Young Adult tiers require the purchaser to be unmarried.
